title: Beyond the Point
html:
An orc raiding party near Underleaf has stripped the west patrol's spare equipment. Tobin Reed needs it back before he sends another pair of guards down that road.

About

Given byGuard Tobin Reed
Level10
LengthMedium
KindCombat skill unlocks
Quest points2
UnlocksThe Spear weapon skill

What you need

Not known yet: the data for this quest is incomplete.

Steps

  1. Talk to Guard Tobin Reed (outdoors near Orc Lair) to get the quest.
  2. Kill orcs near the Orc Lair for 8 Stolen Patrol Fittings - each orc drops one.
  3. Bring the fittings back to Guard Tobin Reed - he tells you who leads the raids.
  4. Kill Varruk the Raider - a level 10 orc at the southwest edge of the same camp.
  5. Go back to Guard Tobin Reed to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold350
Character XP16,000
Spear XP279
Quest points2
ItemsIron Spear
Unlocksthe Spear weapon skill

Unlocks

The Spear weapon skill: this quest is how you learn it (the spear tome is retired). Once you have it you can wield spears, the skill levels with the damage you deal, and it unlocks five special attacks along the way.

What Guard Tobin Reed says

Guard Tobin Reed: These will do. The shafts we can replace ourselves.

You: They'll come for the next cart.

Guard Tobin Reed: Varruk will. He leads their raids from the southwest edge of that same camp. Deal with him before I put another patrol on the road.

Guard Tobin Reed: I'll send the patrol out before dusk. They'll be glad of their kit.

Guard Tobin Reed: This spear's yours. Put your rear hand here and face me.

You: You're well out of reach.

Guard Tobin Reed: Of your sword, yes. Take half a step. There. That's where you want the other fellow when he starts his swing.

Guard Tobin Reed: Keep the point between you and the trouble. Give yourself room to step back. We'll practice until your feet remember it.

Handing it in

"Keep the point between you and the trouble. Give yourself room to step back."
